verses.ar: مَزْمُورٌ. لِآسَافَ إِنَّمَا صَالِحٌ ٱللهُ لِإِسْرَائِيلَ، لِأَنْقِيَاءِ ٱلْقَلْبِ.
verses.kjv: A Psalm of Asaph. Truly God [is] good to Israel, [even] to such as are of a clean heart.
verses.web: A Psalm by Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
verses.he: מִזְמֹ֗ור לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אַ֤ךְ טֹ֭וב לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אֱלֹהִ֗ים לְבָרֵ֥י לֵבָֽב׃

verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنَا فَكَادَتْ تَزِلُّ قَدَمَايَ. لَوْلَا قَلِيلٌ لَزَلِقَتْ خَطَوَاتِي.
verses.kjv: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
verses.web: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.
verses.he: וַאֲנִ֗י כִּ֭מְעַט *נָטוּי (נָטָ֣יוּ) רַגְלָ֑י כְּ֝אַ֗יִן *שֻׁפְּכָה (שֻׁפְּכ֥וּ) אֲשֻׁרָֽי׃

verses.ar: لِأَنِّي غِرْتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ، إِذْ رَأَيْتُ سَلَامَةَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ.
verses.kjv: For I was envious at the foolish, [when] I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
verses.web: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
verses.he: כִּֽי־קִ֭נֵּאתִי בַּֽהֹולְלִ֑ים שְׁלֹ֖ום רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֶרְאֶֽה׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ لَيْسَتْ فِي مَوْتِهِمْ شَدَائِدُ، وَجِسْمُهُمْ سَمِينٌ.
verses.kjv: For [there are] no bands in their death: but their strength [is] firm.
verses.web: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.
verses.he: כִּ֤י אֵ֖ין חַרְצֻבֹּ֥ות לְמֹותָ֗ם וּבָרִ֥יא אוּלָֽם׃

verses.ar: لَيْسُوا فِي تَعَبِ ٱلنَّاسِ، وَمَعَ ٱلْبَشَرِ لَا يُصَابُونَ.
verses.kjv: They [are] not in trouble [as other] men; neither are they plagued like [other] men.
verses.web: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.
verses.he: בַּעֲמַ֣ל אֱנֹ֣ושׁ אֵינֵ֑מֹו וְעִם־אָ֝דָ֗ם לֹ֣א יְנֻגָּֽעוּ׃

verses.ar: لِذَلِكَ تَقَلَّدُوا ٱلْكِبْرِيَاءَ. لَبِسُوا كَثَوْبٍ ظُلْمَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them [as] a garment.
verses.web: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.
verses.he: לָ֭כֵן עֲנָקַ֣תְמֹו גַאֲוָ֑ה יַעֲטָף־שִׁ֝֗ית חָמָ֥ס לָֽמֹו׃

verses.ar: جَحَظَتْ عُيُونُهُمْ مِنَ ٱلشَّحْمِ. جَاوَزُوا تَصَوُّرَاتِ ٱلْقَلْبِ.
verses.kjv: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.
verses.web: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.
verses.he: יָ֭צָא מֵחֵ֣לֶב עֵינֵ֑מֹו עָ֝בְר֗וּ מַשְׂכִּיֹּ֥ות לֵבָֽב׃

verses.ar: يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ وَيَتَكَلَّمُونَ بِٱلشَّرِّ ظُلْمًا. مِنَ ٱلْعَلَاءِ يَتَكَلَّمُونَ.
verses.kjv: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly [concerning] oppression: they speak loftily.
verses.web: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.
verses.he: יָמִ֤יקוּ ׀ וִידַבְּר֣וּ בְרָ֣ע עֹ֑שֶׁק מִמָּרֹ֥ום יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃

verses.ar: جَعَلُوا أَفْوَاهَهُمْ فِي ٱلسَّمَاءِ، وَأَلْسِنَتُهُمْ تَتَمَشَّى فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.
verses.web: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
verses.he: שַׁתּ֣וּ בַשָּׁמַ֣יִם פִּיהֶ֑ם וּ֝לְשֹׁונָ֗ם תִּֽהֲלַ֥ךְ בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

verses.ar: لِذَلِكَ يَرْجِعُ شَعْبُهُ إِلَى هُنَا، وَكَمِيَاهٍ مُرْوِيَةٍ يُمْتَصُّونَ مِنْهُمْ.
verses.kjv: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full [cup] are wrung out to them.
verses.web: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.
verses.he: לָכֵ֤ן ׀ *יָשִׁיב (יָשׁ֣וּב) עַמֹּ֣ו הֲלֹ֑ם וּמֵ֥י מָ֝לֵ֗א יִמָּ֥צוּ לָֽמֹו׃

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا: «كَيْفَ يَعْلَمُ ٱللهُ؟ وَهَلْ عِنْدَ ٱلْعَلِيِّ مَعْرِفَةٌ؟».
verses.kjv: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?
verses.web: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”
verses.he: וְֽאָמְר֗וּ אֵיכָ֥ה יָדַֽע־אֵ֑ל וְיֵ֖שׁ דֵּעָ֣ה בְעֶלְיֹֽון׃

verses.ar: هُوَذَا هَؤُلَاءِ هُمُ ٱلْأَشْرَارُ، وَمُسْتَرِيحِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ يُكْثِرُونَ ثَرْوَةً.
verses.kjv: Behold, these [are] the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase [in] riches.
verses.web: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.
verses.he: הִנֵּה־אֵ֥לֶּה רְשָׁעִ֑ים וְשַׁלְוֵ֥י עֹ֝ולָ֗ם הִשְׂגּוּ־חָֽיִל׃

verses.ar: حَقًّا قَدْ زَكَّيْتُ قَلْبِي بَاطِلًا وَغَسَلْتُ بِٱلنَّقَاوَةِ يَدَيَّ.
verses.kjv: Verily I have cleansed my heart [in] vain, and washed my hands in innocency.
verses.web: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,
verses.he: אַךְ־רִ֭יק זִכִּ֣יתִי לְבָבִ֑י וָאֶרְחַ֖ץ בְּנִקָּיֹ֣ון כַּפָּֽי׃

verses.ar: وَكُنْتُ مُصَابًا ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ، وَتَأَدَّبْتُ كُلَّ صَبَاحٍ.
verses.kjv: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.
verses.web: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.
verses.he: וָאֱהִ֣י נָ֭גוּעַ כָּל־הַיֹּ֑ום וְ֝תֹוכַחְתִּ֗י לַבְּקָרִֽים׃

verses.ar: لَوْ قُلْتُ أُحَدِّثُ هَكَذَا، لَغَدَرْتُ بِجِيلِ بَنِيكَ.
verses.kjv: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend [against] the generation of thy children.
verses.web: If I had said, “I will speak thus”, behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
verses.he: אִם־אָ֭מַרְתִּי אֲסַפְּרָ֥ה כְמֹ֑ו הִנֵּ֤ה דֹ֭ור בָּנֶ֣יךָ בָגָֽדְתִּי׃

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا قَصَدْتُ مَعْرِفَةَ هَذَا، إِذَا هُوَ تَعَبٌ فِي عَيْنَيَّ.
verses.kjv: When I thought to know this, it [was] too painful for me;
verses.web: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me—
verses.he: וָֽ֭אֲחַשְּׁבָה לָדַ֣עַת זֹ֑את עָמָ֖ל *הִיא (ה֣וּא) בְעֵינָֽי׃

verses.ar: حَتَّى دَخَلْتُ مَقَادِسَ ٱللهِ، وَٱنْتَبَهْتُ إِلَى آخِرَتِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; [then] understood I their end.
verses.web: until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.
verses.he: עַד־אָ֭בֹוא אֶל־מִקְדְּשֵׁי־אֵ֑ל אָ֝בִ֗ינָה לְאַחֲרִיתָֽם׃

verses.ar: حَقًّا فِي مَزَالِقَ جَعَلْتَهُمْ. أَسْقَطْتَهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَوَارِ.
verses.kjv: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.
verses.web: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
verses.he: אַ֣ךְ בַּ֭חֲלָקֹות תָּשִׁ֣ית לָ֑מֹו הִ֝פַּלְתָּ֗ם לְמַשּׁוּאֹֽות׃

verses.ar: كَيْفَ صَارُوا لِلْخَرَابِ بَغْتَةً! ٱضْمَحَلُّوا، فَنُوا مِنَ ٱلدَّوَاهِي.
verses.kjv: How are they [brought] into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.
verses.web: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
verses.he: אֵ֤יךְ הָי֣וּ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה כְרָ֑גַע סָ֥פוּ תַ֝֗מּוּ מִן־בַּלָּהֹֽות׃

verses.ar: كَحُلْمٍ عِنْدَ ٱلتَّيَقُّظِ يَارَبُّ، عِنْدَ ٱلتَّيَقُّظِ تَحْتَقِرُ خَيَالَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: As a dream when [one] awaketh; [so], O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.
verses.web: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.
verses.he: כַּחֲלֹ֥ום מֵהָקִ֑יץ אֲ֝דֹנָי בָּעִ֤יר ׀ צַלְמָ֬ם תִּבְזֶֽה׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ تَمَرْمَرَ قَلْبِي، وَٱنْتَخَسْتُ فِي كُلْيَتَيَّ.
verses.kjv: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.
verses.web: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.
verses.he: כִּ֭י יִתְחַמֵּ֣ץ לְבָבִ֑י וְ֝כִלְיֹותַ֗י אֶשְׁתֹּונָֽן׃

verses.ar: وَأَنَا بَلِيدٌ وَلَا أَعْرِفُ. صِرْتُ كَبَهِيمٍ عِنْدَكَ.
verses.kjv: So foolish [was] I, and ignorant: I was [as] a beast before thee.
verses.web: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
verses.he: וַאֲנִי־בַ֭עַר וְלֹ֣א אֵדָ֑ע בְּ֝הֵמֹ֗ות הָיִ֥יתִי עִמָּֽךְ׃

verses.ar: وَلَكِنِّي دَائِمًا مَعَكَ. أَمْسَكْتَ بِيَدِي ٱلْيُمْنَى.
verses.kjv: Nevertheless I [am] continually with thee: thou hast holden [me] by my right hand.
verses.web: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.
verses.he: וַאֲנִ֣י תָמִ֣יד עִמָּ֑ךְ אָ֝חַ֗זְתָּ בְּיַד־יְמִינִֽי׃

verses.ar: بِرَأْيِكَ تَهْدِينِي، وَبَعْدُ إِلَى مَجْدٍ تَأْخُذُنِي.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me [to] glory.
verses.web: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
verses.he: בַּעֲצָתְךָ֥ תַנְחֵ֑נִי וְ֝אַחַ֗ר כָּבֹ֥וד תִּקָּחֵֽנִי׃

verses.ar: مَنْ لِي فِي ٱلسَّمَاءِ؟ وَمَعَكَ لَا أُرِيدُ شَيْئًا فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: Whom have I in heaven [but thee]? and [there is] none upon earth [that] I desire beside thee.
verses.web: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.
verses.he: מִי־לִ֥י בַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ֝עִמְּךָ֗ לֹא־חָפַ֥צְתִּי בָאָֽרֶץ׃

verses.ar: قَدْ فَنِيَ لَحْمِي وَقَلْبِي. صَخْرَةُ قَلْبِي وَنَصِيبِي ٱللهُ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ.
verses.kjv: My flesh and my heart faileth: [but] God [is] the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
verses.web: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
verses.he: כָּלָ֥ה שְׁאֵרִ֗י וּלְבָ֫בִ֥י צוּר־לְבָבִ֥י וְחֶלְקִ֗י אֱלֹהִ֥ים לְעֹולָֽם׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ هُوَذَا ٱلْبُعَدَاءُ عَنْكَ يَبِيدُونَ. تُهْلِكُ كُلَّ مَنْ يَزْنِي عَنْكَ.
verses.kjv: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.
verses.web: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.
verses.he: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֣ה רְחֵקֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ הִ֝צְמַ֗תָּה כָּל־זֹונֶ֥ה מִמֶּֽךָּ׃

verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنَا فَٱلِٱقْتِرَابُ إِلَى ٱللهِ حَسَنٌ لِي. جَعَلْتُ بِٱلسَّيِّدِ ٱلرَّبِّ مَلْجَإِي، لِأُخْبِرَ بِكُلِّ صَنَائِعِكَ.
verses.kjv: But [it is] good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works.
verses.web: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
verses.he: וַאֲנִ֤י ׀ קִֽרֲבַ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֗ים לִ֫י־טֹ֥וב שַׁתִּ֤י ׀ בַּאדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י לְ֝סַפֵּ֗ר כָּל־מַלְאֲכֹותֶֽיךָ׃
